//==
// # IImage containers
//
// Images that hold something other than one plain 2D pixel grid: compressed
// file payloads, mip pyramids, tile grids, frame sequences, regions of
// interest, voxel volumes, and cubemap face sets. The single-grid pixel types
// they are built from are the section above.

//==
// ## Encoded, tiled, and multi-resolution images

// A compressed image file format; Hdr is Radiance HDR.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Image_file_format)
type ImageCodec
    = Png | Jpeg | WebP | Gif | Bmp | Tga | Tiff | Exr | Hdr | Ktx2 | Dds | Avif | Heic;
